summary: Horizon Bancorp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose a jury verdict of ~$3.0M (including $2.5M punitive damages) against its subsidiary Horizon Bank from a 2018 auto repossession lawsuit. The company will book a $3.0M pre-tax expense in Q2 2026 and plans to appeal. This is a routine litigation disclosure, not a special situation like M&A or restructuring. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic changes are involved. The event does not affect the core community bank model. Watch for appeal outcome and Q2 earnings call for any material impact.
